quotes.text: Our deepest fear is not that we are inadequate. Our deepest fear is that we are powerful beyond measure.
quotes.speaker: Timo Cruz
quotes.attribution: Adapted from Marianne Williamson, 'A Return to Love: Reflections on the Principles of A Course in Miracles' (1992). Credit her whenever the line is shown.
quotes.wording_note: Both IMDb and Wikiquote open the speech with these two sentences (full speech is ~110 words).

quotes.text: Sir, I just wanna say thank you. You saved my life.
quotes.speaker: Timo Cruz
quotes.wording_note: Wikiquote gives it twice ('wanna say' / 'wanted to say'); the clip's caption track reads 'Sir, I just wanna say thank you.'

quotes.text: I came to coach basketball players, and you became students. I came to teach boys, and you became men.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter

quotes.text: But you men played like champions, and never gave up. And champions hold their heads high.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Wikiquote only (not on IMDb's quotes page).

quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter and the team

quotes.text: You said we're a team. One person struggles, we all struggle. One person triumphs, we all triumph.
quotes.speaker: Jason Lyle
quotes.wording_note: IMDb and Wikiquote agree on this wording; the clip's fan caption track reads 'One player triumphs'.

quotes.text: Sir, they can cut the chains off the door, but they can't make us play.
quotes.speaker: Jason Lyle

quotes.text: We've decided we're going to finish what you've started, sir.
quotes.speaker: Damien Carter

quotes.text: I'm not a teacher. I'm the new basketball coach.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Wikiquote dialogue section (reply to 'Teachers ain't supposed to touch students').

quotes.text: These boys are student athletes. "Student" comes first.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: IMDb (parents' meeting scene). Not in any of the 9 Movieclips scenes; heard in the trailer.

quotes.text: I promise you I'll do everything in my power to get you to college and to a better life.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Closing line of the 'stats' speech on IMDb.

quotes.text: As of now, you are a sir. So are the rest of you. "Sir" is a term of respect, and you will have my respect until you abuse it.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Wikiquote wording; heard in the Day One scene at 1:17 (caption track).

quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: Basketball is a privilege. If you want to play basketball on this team, these are the simple rules you have to follow.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: Part of growing up is making your own decisions and living with the consequences.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: We are a team. And until we all meet the terms of this contract, the gym will remain locked.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: I took this job because I wanted to effect change in a special group of young men.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: If you vote to end the lockout, you won't have to terminate me. I'll quit.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

quotes.text: Those are some stats for your ass.
quotes.speaker: Coach Ken Carter
quotes.wording_note: Film audio, checked against the scene's caption track (2026-11-09).

real_vs_film.real: Ken Carter padlocked the Richmond High gym and cancelled practices and games in early January 1999 while the Oilers were 13-0.
15 of the program's 45 players (varsity, JV and freshman) had broken the academic contract — tardiness, missing homework, GPA under 2.3.
The contract said 'basketball is the hook and education is the goal'; CNN described a 19-point pledge incl. 10 study hours a week and front-row seating.
The lockout lasted about a week: on Jan 11, 1999 school officials announced all 45 players met the criteria and the season resumed without forfeits.
real_vs_film.film: In the film the school board votes to end the lockout over Carter's objection and the team chooses to keep studying.

real_vs_film.real: Carter was a 1977 Richmond High graduate who held the school's scoring record and owned a sporting-goods store.
His son Damien Carter was on the 1999 team (quoted by CNN); the film's Damien Carter is played by Robert Ri'chard.
